sq.ANSWER:
Actual parameters are the values passed to a function when it is called.
Formal parameters are the variables defined in the function declaration to receive the passed values.
Example:
void greet(String name) { // 'name' is a formal parameter
    System.out.println("Hello " + name);
}
greet("John"); // "John" is the actual parameter
